title: Time is ready while desire waits

captions.physics: Organising a definite time for leisure
captions.emotions: Feeling ready to join in together

meaning: Shared pleasure can wait among prepared conditions when seeking the right moment postpones participation already available.
text: You can organise leisure carefully and still leave it at the threshold. The Emperor in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps set time aside, prepare a place and agree a format. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards delaying the beginning for another perspective or a more suitable moment. The Chariot in emotions brings readiness to join in and feel shared movement. The arrangement exists, desire waits for permission and the emotional response reaches towards action. Pausing can become especially noticeable when both are ready to enjoy yourselves yet another preparation always appears.

Suppose you reserve an hour for a puzzle together. The box is open and the table cleared, but first you want to finish the instructions, examine another method and check every piece. **Prepared leisure comes alive through your participation.** One trial move already lets you feel excitement and understand the process together. Beginning can allow incomplete knowledge when you remain free to pause for an explanation.

The difficulty is answering impatience with stricter preparation. To prevent any later interruption, you postpone enjoyment now until the available time disappears. Determination finds no use and becomes irritation with obstacles. A pause helps when it changes perspective and restores a next step. Once conditions are sufficiently clear, a small trial brings pleasure beyond endlessly waiting for the right beginning.
